cards: The Tilde Card: a business card you print yourself, with a QR code and an optional NFC sticker. Make your own design, with some to start from, and print it yourself.
fobs: Tilde fobs: coins and tags for your keys, with an NFC sticker inside. Every shape, color and icon, and how to print your own.
uses: One tag, one job: eight things an NFC tag can do, from your family’s number to guest Wi-Fi, and how to make each one.
app: Tilde for Android: your business card on your phone. Tap phones to share, write your own NFC tags, and remember who you met. Free, with no account.
hub: Tilde is a business card for a tap or a scan: a free Android app, and cards and tags you print yourself.
